strategies.description: Upgrade log4j-core to a vendor-supported version that has remediated CVE-2021-44228.
constraints: Upgrade must be validated against application compatibility.
Vendor-supported remediated version must be confirmed before deployment.
strategies.rationale: CVE-2021-44228 is a critical vulnerability with CVSS 10.0, and upgrading resolves the root cause by eliminating the vulnerable version.

strategies.description: Isolate the payment-api service from external network access to prevent exploitation.
constraints: Isolation must be applied to the payment-api service immediately.
Network isolation may impact service availability.
strategies.rationale: Immediate isolation reduces the attack surface and prevents lateral movement or exploitation of the exposed endpoint.

strategies.description: Block all future deployments of the payment-api service until a secure version is validated and rolled out.
constraints: Deployment of the payment-api service must be halted until a verified fix is implemented.
This action may affect business operations requiring payment processing.
strategies.rationale: Blocking deployment prevents any new instances from being exposed to the vulnerable version, reducing the potential attack surface.

strategies.description: Enhance monitoring to detect and alert on suspicious activity related to the vulnerable endpoint.
constraints: Monitoring must be configured to detect unusual activity on the payment-api endpoint.
Alerts must be routed to security operations personnel.
strategies.rationale: While monitoring does not eliminate the vulnerability, it enables early detection of exploitation attempts.
